facts.business: Indokem Limited manufactures and sells textile chemicals, dyes, and pigments with a focus on sustainable chemical solutions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The outlook for our portfolio remains stable for FY 2026–27, and our medium-term prospects remain positive.
guidance_or_targets.value: Sustained revenue growth and improved operating margins

auditor.name: M/s. Mayur More & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Auditor observed a delay of one day in submission of Annual Report per Regulation 34 of SEBI LODR; fine paid to BSE.

key_risks: Sectoral, operational, sustainability, cyber, and financial risks
Increasing environmental regulations and compliance costs
Volatility in global raw material supply and pricing

Heightened geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, along with increasing trade fragmentation between major economies, leading to volatility in energy prices and disruptions in supply chains
Volatility in foreign exchange rates and uncertainties in raw material availability may impact sales realisations and margins
Environmental compliance costs expected to remain elevated given inherently high effluent treatment requirements in the Dyes and Pigments industry
Regulatory directions from Maharashtra Pollution Control Board relating to environmental compliance at Ambernath manufacturing facility
